settings.title: Shipping
settings.content:
Fast Australia-wide shipping at discounted rates — you'll see your price at checkout once you enter your address. Large items arrive on a pallet and are delivered to where the driver has safe access; for safety reasons drivers can't carry items inside or upstairs.

Brisbane collection: collect from Unit 2A/919-925 Nudgee Road, Banyo QLD 4014, Monday to Friday 8.30am–5pm.

Regional? We can often send to your nearest depot for less. Call +61 404 969 244 or email support@vulcanfitness.com.au. Shipping & delivery details

settings.title: Installation
settings.content:
We have installers in every major city across Australia. Installing a pin-loaded leg extension / leg curl machine is typically $350–$500, depending on your area.

Install estimates don't include shipping. Email support@vulcanfitness.com.au with the items you'd like installed and we'll quote installation and delivery together — or ask us about a full-gym fit-out. See installation rates

settings.subtitle: Not right for your floor? Send it back.
settings.content:
Try it in your home or facility for 90 days. If you don't love it, contact us to organise a return and we'll refund the product once it's back in our warehouse. Shipping and return costs aren't refunded, and equipment must come back in its original packaging.
